narrative.headline: Top 50 mega-cap tape is flat — every name printed NEUTRAL with no directional conviction from flow, dark pools, or blocks.
narrative.rotation_signal: No accumulation or distribution signal detectable across the Top 50. Either premium is balanced call/put within the Core DTE band, or activity is concentrated in excluded far-OTM strikes and short-dated noise. This is a low-conviction tape — institutions are not pressing either side in mega-caps.
narrative.diverging_from_industry_layer: None at the single-name level, but the entire Top 50 sitting at NEUTRAL is itself a divergence to watch — if the broader industry layer is showing directional skew, the mega-cap complex is not confirming it.
